units.rawText: Are you afraid I'll end up breaking the other furniture if I hold it with one hand? Pardon me; I'll be more careful.

units.rawText: Hm? No, it's not heavy at all. It's just a bed. It's nothing compared to my drilling gear.

units.rawText: My equipment was designed to drill for and gather information on oil deposits in varied environments. Just like me, they're made strong enough to work in high-pressure, high-heat, and other such adverse environments.

units.rawText: You want to know how I managed to reproduced them on the cloud? I specially commissioned Miss Riko to get the appropriate materials. Hm? How much did it cost? Well, it was about this much... Huh? Professor, why are you making a face like that?
